From: #<issue> Touches: \<core path | ADR-NNNN | plan scope>

## What

The exact change, in one or two sentences. Type names and file paths.

## Why

The behaviour that is impossible or wrong without it.

## Invariant touched

Quote the line from the `CLAUDE.md` invariants or the ADR, or write "none". Anything but "none" is decided by the user.

## Proof

The test that fails today and passes after.

## Cost

Work items it adds. The smaller alternative that was considered.
